purpose: Statistics-only diagnosis of text budget allocation (D1) and rule-based cleanup (D2) against the frozen EXP-011 D0 scheme. No model inference, no training, no LLM.

d0.definition: EXP-011 frozen builder (repro_mm_timesx_v1/text_builder.py build_tokens): skip block if field is empty/whitespace or the literal 'Unknown' (case-insensitive after strip); otherwise tokenize 'Name: raw' (add_special_tokens=False) and keep the FIRST min(raw_tokens, budget) tokens; no budget transfer; budgets include the block-name tokens.
d0.scope: D0 tokens for the 2474 test windows must be bitwise identical to cache/text_tokens_M48T512.npz

d1.definition: Recover idle budget only; field texts, order, and missing-handling identical to D0.
d1.base_alloc: alloc[f] = min(raw_tokens[f], budget[f]) for every block (skipped blocks: raw=0)
d1.redistribute_rule: leftover = 510 - sum(alloc); walk the order once, giving min(need, leftover) to each block with alloc < raw_tokens; stop when leftover == 0
d1.invariant: alloc_d1[f] >= alloc_d0[f] for every block (asserted per window)

d2.definition: Deterministic rule cleanup (d2_rules.json) applied to the four field strings FIRST, then the D1 allocation method on the cleaned token counts.
d2.missing_handling: identical to D0 (empty/'Unknown' skip); a rule never makes a non-empty field empty

assembly.name_prefix: '{block_name}: ' + field_text, tokenized as one string exactly like D0 (the block name is added HERE and only here; clean functions return field text without the block name)
assembly.structure: [CLS] + content + [SEP]; right-pad to 512 with pad id 0, attention mask 0
assembly.boundary_meta: per-block [start, end) token spans inside the 512 sequence

token_convention: raw_tokens and cleaned_tokens are counted on 'Name: <field text>' (name included), matching D0's convention
